# dragon_knight (고룡기사)

## Identity

- Elite dragon-blood knight, attacker role, natural 5★
- Tall human male warrior in heavy jagged dragon-scale plate armor
- Horned draconic helm with narrow visor; pale stern face partially visible
- Charcoal-black scale plates with sharp obsidian edges and layered pauldrons
- Large tattered dragon wings with membrane glow and a long torn battle cape
- Massive two-handed volcanic greatsword with magma core in the blade
- Magma-orange light bleeds through armor seams at chest, belt, knees and blade
- Grounded wide combat stance, sword tip near the ground in the right hand
- **Keep across elements**: human knight body, horned helm, scale armor layout,
  wing and cape structure, greatsword silhouette, wide grounded stance
- **Change per element**: seam glow, wing membrane energy, blade aura and pauldron trim only

## artKey

`dragon_knight_{element}` — fire / water / wind / light / dark

## Element variants

- **fire**: orange-red magma seams, ember wing membranes, volcanic blade glow
- **water**: teal-blue seam light, wet metal highlights, frost-ice blade core
- **wind**: emerald-lime seam energy, airy wing trails, sharp wind-etched blade
- **light**: gold-white holy seam radiance, bright wing membranes, radiant blade core
- **dark**: violet-black void seams, shadow mist on wings, curse-glyph blade aura

## Awaken delta

- Same silhouette with evolved horned crown-helm and heavier wing armature
- Blade grows longer with split magma/element core and ornate crossguard
- Cape becomes armored mantle; pauldrons gain dragon-skull trim
- Brighter controlled elemental aura without hiding the body
- Portrait: dragon_knight_{element}_awaken.webp
- Battle: dragon_knight_{element}-awaken-front.webp / -awaken-back.webp

## Front/back requirements

- **front**: helm face slit, chest seams, sword, wings leading edge and boots readable
- **back**: wing membrane structure, cape attachment, rear scale plates, sword spine visible
- Back must not mirror the front

## Battle prompt block

```text
Premium stylized 2.5D mobile RPG dragon knight, tall human male heavy warrior,
horned draconic helm, charcoal dragon-scale plate with obsidian edges,
large tattered dragon wings and torn battle cape,
massive two-handed greatsword with glowing elemental core,
element accents in armor seams wings and blade only,
high-end hand-painted dark fantasy over dimensional 3D-like forms,
eye-level front three-quarter grounded combat stance, full body safe margin,
transparent alpha background or solid magenta #FF00FF plate, no global recolor, no chibi, no text, no cropped sword or wings
```
No text, no watermark, no UI, no cropped limbs or equipment.

# heal_priest (치유사제)

## Identity

- Adult human priestess healer, support role, natural 2★
- Calm oval face, long ash-blonde hair and a deep ceremonial hood
- Layered ivory robe with charcoal inner lining, fitted silver-bronze torso armor,
  long split sleeves and pointed embroidered hems
- Tall one-handed healing staff with a winged circular head and central crystal
- Rigid sun-halo frame mounted behind the shoulders; not free-floating
- Soft leather boots remain visible beneath the robe for a grounded stance
- **Keep across elements**: face, ash-blonde hair, ivory robe base, hood shape,
  staff silhouette, shoulder-mounted halo and robe layering
- **Change per element**: crystal, eye light, embroidery, metal trim and restrained
  healing particles; never recolor all cloth or change her into an attacker

## artKey

`heal_priest_{element}` — fire / water / wind / light / dark

## Element variants

- **fire**: amber crystal, red-gold embroidery, warm restorative flame motes
- **water**: teal crystal, blue-silver trim, droplets and cool healing ribbons
- **wind**: emerald crystal, green-gold stitching, leaves and soft air ribbons
- **light**: pale-gold crystal, bright ivory-gold trim and restrained holy motes
- **dark**: violet crystal, black-silver trim and controlled restorative shadow wisps

## Awaken delta

- Same face, body and staff silhouette with more ornate fitted torso armor
- Evolved double-ring shoulder halo, jeweled hood diadem and longer embroidered mantle
- Staff head gains a second wing layer and larger central crystal
- Four short spectral ribbon-wings emerge from the halo without hiding the robe
- Portrait: heal_priest_{element}_awaken.webp
- Battle: heal_priest_{element}-awaken-front.webp / -awaken-back.webp

## Front/back requirements

- **front**: face, staff head, chest emblem, both sleeves and boots readable
- **back**: halo mounting bracket, hood and hair, mantle, sleeve backs and robe panels visible
- Back keeps the staff in the same hand and is never a mirrored front

## Battle prompt block

```text
Premium stylized 2.5D mobile RPG healer, adult human hooded priestess,
calm face and long ash-blonde hair, layered ivory ceremonial robe with charcoal lining,
fitted silver-bronze torso armor, split sleeves and embroidered pointed hems,
tall winged circular healing staff with central crystal,
rigid sun-halo frame mounted behind shoulders, visible leather boots,
high-end hand-painted dark fantasy over dimensional 3D-like forms,
physically believable silk leather and metal, eye-level front three-quarter camera,
grounded full-body support stance, safe margin, transparent alpha background or solid magenta #FF00FF plate,
element accents only on crystal eyes embroidery trim and healing particles,
no global robe recolor, no attack pose, no text, no cropped staff or feet
```
No text, no watermark, no UI, no cropped limbs or equipment.

# moss_turtle (이끼거북)

## Identity

- Ancient colossal tortoise guardian, tank role, natural 1★
- Low, extremely broad quadruped stance with thick pillar legs and blunt claws
- Weathered mountain-like shell made from overlapping dark stone plates
- Living moss, short vines and small fern growth follow shell seams
- Stern reptilian face, heavy brow, short hooked beak and thick scaled neck
- Bronze rune collar and one central shield-shaped chest plate; no handheld weapon
- **Keep across elements**: olive-black scales, mountain shell structure, moss coverage,
  broad body proportions, collar and chest plate
- **Change per element**: eye glow, shell-seam energy, rune light and small elemental
  growths only; never recolor the entire turtle or replace moss with a full effect cloud

## artKey

`moss_turtle_{element}` — fire / water / wind / light / dark

## Element variants

- **fire**: orange eyes, ember cracks between stone plates, sparse charred moss tips
- **water**: teal eyes, wet stone highlights, tiny shell-edge rivulets and blue lichen
- **wind**: green eyes, lifted fern tips, a few leaves and restrained air ribbons
- **light**: gold eyes and runes, pale flowers, warm highlights on bronze and stone
- **dark**: violet eyes and runes, black-blue stone seams, sparse shadow spores

## Awaken delta

- Same body and shell silhouette with a taller central shell ridge
- Evolved bronze-gold rune collar, larger chest shield and carved shell-edge bands
- Ancient tree stump or crystal crown rooted into the shell center, element-specific glow
- Denser but controlled moss and brighter shell-seam energy
- Portrait: moss_turtle_{element}_awaken.webp
- Battle: moss_turtle_{element}-awaken-front.webp / -awaken-back.webp

## Front/back requirements

- **front**: head, both front legs, chest shield and front half of shell readable
- **back**: dedicated rear 3/4 view showing the full mountain-shell layout, rear legs,
  short tail, rune bands and vegetation placement
- Back must not be a mirrored front and must not turn the head toward the camera

## Battle prompt block

```text
Premium stylized 2.5D mobile RPG battle creature, colossal ancient tortoise guardian,
low broad quadruped stance, olive-black scales, stern hooked-beak reptilian face,
weathered mountain shell of overlapping dark stone plates, living moss vines and ferns,
bronze rune collar and central shield-shaped chest plate, no handheld weapon,
high-end hand-painted dark fantasy over dimensional 3D-like forms,
physically believable stone scales moss and bronze, eye-level three-quarter camera,
grounded feet, full body with safe margin, transparent alpha or pure #FF00FF plate,
element accents only in eyes runes shell seams and small growths,
no global recolor, no ordinary small pet turtle, no cartoon, no text, no cropped shell
```
No text, no watermark, no UI, no cropped limbs or equipment.

# abyss_priest (심연사제)

## Identity

- Gothic dark priest debuffer, natural 4★
- Pointed crown-like hood shadowing pale face with glowing element eye slits
- Layered dark gothic plate armor with diamond element gems on chest shoulders waist
- Long tattered black robes; shadow tendrils emanating from back and sides
- Tall ornate staff with large glowing element orb containing vertical eye slit
- Raised hand with element energy wisps around fingers
- Imposing forward caster stance
- **Keep across elements**: priest proportions, pointed hood crown, gem layout,
  robe layers, staff orb eye, tendril motion, stance
- **Change per element**: eye glow, gem color, orb hue, tendril energy, hand wisps only

## artKey

`abyss_priest_{element}` — fire / water / wind / light / dark

- Hood crown taller; staff orb evolves twin-ring eye sigil
- Heavier shoulder plates; tendrils denser with rune glyphs

- Battle: abyss_priest_{element}-awaken-front.webp / -awaken-back.webp

```text
Premium stylized 2.5D mobile RPG gothic dark priest debuffer,
pointed hood crown pale face element eye slits, dark plate armor diamond gems,
tattered black robes shadow tendrils, staff with glowing orb eye slit,
raised hand element energy wisps, imposing caster stance,
high-end hand-painted dark fantasy, eye-level front three-quarter, transparent alpha background or solid magenta #FF00FF plate,
element accents in eyes gems orb tendrils only, no global recolor, no text
```
No text, no watermark, no UI, no cropped limbs or equipment.

# gale_bat (바람박쥐)

## Identity

- Bipedal bat humanoid debuffer, natural 1★
- Dark fur body with white fluffy neck ruff, large pointed bat ears
- Glowing element-colored eyes, sharp fang snarl
- Wide spread leathery bat wings with silver-tipped bone spurs
- Dark ornate chest-and-belt armor with diamond gem buckle
- Tattered dark cloak panels hanging from waist
- Sharp three-claw hands and bird-like clawed feet
- Aggressive forward lunge stance with one claw extended
- Circular elemental energy ring swirling around the body
- **Keep across elements**: bat proportions, wing spread, ear shape,
  armor layout, gem buckle, cloak panels, energy ring motion
- **Change per element**: eye glow, gem color, energy ring hue, cloak trim only

## artKey

`gale_bat_{element}` — fire / water / wind / light / dark

## Element variants

- **fire**: amber-red eyes, ruby gem, ember energy ring, charred cloak edges
- **water**: teal eyes, sapphire gem, water-vortex energy ring, cool blue trim
- **wind**: green eyes, emerald gem, classic gale energy ring, green trim
- **light**: gold eyes, topaz gem, radiant holy energy ring, pale gold trim
- **dark**: violet eyes, amethyst gem, void curse energy ring, purple trim

## Awaken delta

- Same silhouette with larger wing span and taller ear crown
- Gem buckle evolves into twin-core crystal; energy ring denser
- Cloak gains ornate rune trim; wing bone spurs longer
- Portrait: gale_bat_{element}_awaken.webp
- Battle: gale_bat_{element}-awaken-front.webp / -awaken-back.webp

## Front/back requirements

- **front**: face, ears, gem buckle, extended claw, wing leading edge readable
- **back**: wing membrane backs, cloak rear panels, tail if any, armor back
- Back must not mirror the front

## Battle prompt block

```text
Premium stylized 2.5D mobile RPG bipedal bat humanoid debuffer,
dark fur white neck ruff, large bat ears, spread leathery wings,
ornate armor with diamond gem buckle, tattered cloak panels,
circular elemental energy ring, aggressive claw lunge stance,
high-end hand-painted dark fantasy, eye-level front three-quarter,
grounded clawed feet visible, transparent alpha background or solid magenta #FF00FF plate,
element accents in eyes gem energy ring and cloak trim only,
no global recolor, no text, no cropped wings or feet
```
No text, no watermark, no UI, no cropped limbs or equipment.

# crow_scout (까마귀정찰)

## Identity

- Anthropomorphic raven humanoid capturer, natural 1★
- Black feathered body with sharp beak and glowing element eyes
- Hooded tattered dark cloak over shoulders
- Crisscross leather chest straps with metal rings
- Leather belt with square glowing buckle and side pouches
- Ragged loincloth panel; leather bracers and greaves with rune engravings
- Large taloned hands and bird claw feet
- Crouched predatory forward stance, claws spread
- Ethereal energy wisps from eyes, shoulders and claw tips
- **Keep across elements**: raven proportions, hood cloak, strap layout,
  belt buckle shape, bracer greave placement, crouched scout stance
- **Change per element**: eye glow, buckle color, rune glow, energy wisps only

## artKey

`crow_scout_{element}` — fire / water / wind / light / dark

## Element variants

- **fire**: amber eyes, ruby buckle, ember rune glow, flame wisps
- **water**: teal eyes, sapphire buckle, cool rune glow, mist wisps
- **wind**: green eyes, emerald buckle, classic gale rune glow, air wisps
- **light**: gold eyes, topaz buckle, holy rune glow, radiant wisps
- **dark**: violet eyes, amethyst buckle, void rune glow, curse wisps

## Awaken delta

- Same silhouette with taller hood crown and broader wing-feather mantle
- Buckle evolves into twin-core crystal; runes brighter on all armor
- Cloak gains ornate trim; talons longer with energy trails
- Portrait: crow_scout_{element}_awaken.webp
- Battle: crow_scout_{element}-awaken-front.webp / -awaken-back.webp

## Front/back requirements

- **front**: beak, hood, buckle, bracer runes, extended talons readable
- **back**: cloak rear, feather mantle, belt pouch backs, greave backs
- Back must not mirror the front

## Battle prompt block

```text
